scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The logs disagree
scenes.caption: Asha receives four synthetic events from different portal components. One clock is known to run two minutes fast. A gateway records a successful response but does not record how many bytes reached the client. Another component records an access denial on a different path.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A name in a log is not a person
scenes.caption: A session label identifies an account context, not necessarily the person at the keyboard. A successful status code alone does not prove the full file was received. Missing response-size evidence and a different request path limit the conclusion.
scenes.dialogue: Keep facts, hypotheses and unknowns separate.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Normalise before correlating
scenes.caption: Apply only the supplied clock correction, preserve raw times and compare request paths and session identifiers. Record alternative explanations such as session misuse or a path-specific denial. Do not invent missing records to force a neat story.
scenes.dialogue: Corrected time supports correlation, not certainty.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose an evidence statement
scenes.caption: A gateway log says status two hundred, but response bytes are unknown. Does that prove the entire registration file was stolen by the account holder? Choose the statement that matches the evidence limit.
scenes.dialogue: A successful response is an indicator, not complete attribution.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A careful evidence ledger
scenes.caption: The team keeps the request event as an observed fact, treats possible disclosure as a hypothesis and records missing bytes and attribution as unknowns. The initial alert still deserves proportionate verification and containment by authorised staff.
scenes.dialogue: Uncertainty does not mean ignoring the risk.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the evidence lab
scenes.caption: Classify facts and hypotheses, correct the known clock offset and preserve a timeline with missing evidence. State at least one alternative explanation without investigating or accusing a real person.
scenes.dialogue: Let the evidence set the confidence.
